dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The surface contains approximately 20 high-luminance, roughly circular blobs arranged in a non-random grid pattern. These blobs are organized into four vertical columns that follow the anterior-to-posterior orientation of the fin. The spatial distribution is highly regular, with relatively uniform inter-blob distances both vertically and horizontally.

other_distinctive_markers: Faint vertical and horizontal bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, forming a rectilinear grid that intersects at the centroids of the primary high-luminance spots.
